source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.2 with Figs. 9.3 to 9.9 and Examples 9.2 and 9.3 (PDF 195-198).

blocks.text: Hum parh chuke hain ke doosre charges ki presence (maujoodgi) mein kisi charge par electrostatic force lagti hai. Ek positive (musbat) charged cheez O lein. Agar point A par chhota charge +q rakhein to O ki wajah se us par electrostatic force F lagegi. Is liye kehte hain ke point A par electric field maujood hai. Coulomb's law (Coulomb ka qanoon) batata hai ke A jitna O ke qareeb ho, field utni strong (taqatwar) hoti hai (Fig. 9.3). Kisi jagah field strength (taqat) ko us point par field ki intensity kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Circle O jis mein + nishan hain (positive charged body). O se dashed lakeer nuqte A tak jahan chhota narangi charge +q hai; A se surkh teer F seedha O se door.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.3 (kitab ki Figure 9.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: O positive hai aur +q bhi positive, is liye force F dhakelne wali (repulsive) hai aur O se door ki taraf hai. A jitna O ke qareeb, F utni zyada; isi force fi unit charge ko field E = F/q kehte hain.

blocks.title: Electric intensity
blocks.text: Kisi point par electric intensity (ya sirf electric field) woh force hai jo us point par rakhe gaye ek unit positive charge par lagti hai.
Electric intensity ek force hai (fi unit charge), is liye yeh vector quantity hai (magnitude (miqdar) ke saath direction (rukh) bhi rakhti hai). Ise E se likhte hain:
Eq. 9.8 se electric intensity ki unit newton per coulomb (N C⁻¹) hai. E ki direction wahi hai jo F ki. Isi equation ko yun bhi likh sakte hain:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan do dafa "Eq. 9.5" likhti hai; murad Eq. 9.8 (E = F/q) hai. Eq. 9.5 to Coulomb force ki vector shakal hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Point charge q se faasle r par field: E = F/q₀ = (1/4πε₀)(q/r²). Yani field bhi faasle ke square ke inversely proportional ghatti hai.

blocks.alt: Baen taraf +q1 aur daen taraf +q2 (nuqta O), lakeer se jure; neeche dashed do-teer 3.0 m. Nuqta P darmiyan mein q2 ke qareeb; oopar do-teer P se q2 tak faasla d.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.4 (kitab ki Figure 9.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: P par q₁ ki field E₁ daen taraf (q₁ se door) aur q₂ ki field E₂ baen taraf (q₂ se door) hai. Jahan dono barabar hon wahan kul field zero hai. Yeh point chhote charge q₂ ke qareeb hota hai, isi liye d = 1.0 m aaya.

blocks.title: Example 9.2
blocks.problem: Do positive point charges q₁ = 16.0 μC aur q₂ = 4.0 μC ek doosre se 3.0 m door hain (Fig. 9.4). Un ko milane wali lakeer par woh jagah maloom karein jahan electric field zero ho.
steps: Dono charges ke darmiyan un ki fields ulti direction mein hain, is liye point P par field zero hogi jahan E₁ = E₂ ho. P ka q₂ se faasla d maan lein; phir q₁ se faasla (3.0 − d) hai.
1/4πε₀ dono taraf cut jata hai: 16.0 × 10⁻⁶ C/(9.0 + d² − 6d) = 4.0 × 10⁻⁶ C/d²
Cross multiply: 16d² = 4(9.0 + d² − 6d), yani 12d² + 24d − 36 = 0, ya d² + 2d − 3 = 0
(d + 3)(d − 1) = 0, is liye d = +1 m ya d = −3 m
d = −3 m dono charges ke daen taraf bahar wali jagah hai; wahan E₁ aur E₂ barabar to hain magar ek hi direction mein, is liye cut nahi hote. Is liye sahi jawab positive qeemat hai.
blocks.answer: Field q₂ se 1.0 m door (dono charges ke darmiyan) zero hai: d = +1.0 m.

blocks.title: Example 9.3
blocks.problem: Electric field ke kisi point par proton par lagne wali electrostatic force us ke weight (wazan) ke barabar hai. Wahan field intensity kitni hai? Proton ka mass = 1.67 × 10⁻²⁷ kg, charge e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C.
steps: Force = weight, yani qE = mg, is liye E = F/q = mg/e
Qeematein rakhein: E = (1.67 × 10⁻²⁷ kg × 9.8 m s⁻²)/(1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C)
blocks.answer: E = 1.0 × 10⁻⁷ N C⁻¹ (bohat kamzor field kaafi hai, kyun ke proton ka weight bohat kam hai).
